notes.398: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: '__foo, __bar__, baz__' expects <strong> wrapping the whole phrase but the delimiter-stack algorithm creates nested <strong> for the inner __bar__ part. All major reference implementations (commonmark.js, commonmark.py, markdown-it) produce the same nested output; only cmark-gfm (C) collapses to a single <strong>. Accepted as a documented deviation.
notes.426: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: residual delimiter runs of even length (>=4) nest in commonmark.js/py/md-it but collapse in cmark-gfm. Accepted as documented deviation; matches ecosystem behavior.
notes.434: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: residual underscore delimiter runs (even length >=4) nest instead of collapsing. Same root cause as 398/426. Accepted as documented deviation.
notes.435: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: same root cause — residual delimiter re-matching produces nested emphasis where cmark-gfm collapses. Accepted as documented deviation.
notes.436: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: same root cause. Accepted as documented deviation.
notes.473: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: '****foo****' produces foo (two nesting levels) instead of single foo. All major impls (commonmark.js, commonmark.py, markdown-it) produce the nested form; only cmark-gfm collapses. Accepted as documented deviation — matches ecosystem behavior.
notes.474: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: '____foo____' (underscore) — same root cause as 473. Accepted as documented deviation.
notes.475: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: '******foo******' produces three nesting levels in commonmark.js/py/md-it; cmark-gfm collapses to single strong. Accepted as documented deviation.
notes.477: cmark-gfm emphasis divergence: '_____foo_____' (5+5 underscores) produces extra nesting layer in commonmark.js/py/md-it vs cmark-gfm. Accepted as documented deviation.
notes.619: harness artifact: this is a CommonMark-base example (fence-info 'example', no extension) expecting bare 'http://' URLs to remain literal. This parser enables GFM extended autolinks unconditionally (per GFM conformance target), so bare URLs are autolinked as correct GFM behavior. The harness cannot toggle extensions per-example.
notes.620: harness artifact: same as 619, for bare email address. GFM extended autolinks correctly autolink it; the CommonMark-base example expects literal. Harness limitation.
notes.645: inline raw HTML: degenerate comment '<!-->' / '<!--->' (HTML comment that starts with '>' or '->' after '<!--') is not matched by the inline HTML-comment regex and is escaped as text; cmark-gfm passes it through raw. Low-impact obscure edge case; accepted as documented deviation.
